description: 高速道路時系列データ [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 全国の高速道路網の路線及び接続部について、路線名、地点名、供用開始年、供用更新年等などの情報を路線形状（線）、接続部位置（点）ごとに時系列的に整理したものです。 対象は、高速自動車国道、高速自動車国道に並行する自動車専用道路、一般国道の自動車専用道路、本州四国連絡高速道路、指定都市高速道路（首都高速道路、阪神高速道路、名古屋高速道路、広島... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (some restrictions). Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
